summary: Fresh read of the final build: a complete, honest, demo-track-shaped paper. The arc is complete — problem (provenance lost at pack time), three design decisions (one address space; ranking proposes, reading disposes; failure as a first-class output), system workflow, three attendee scenarios, a measured three-mode run with explicit limitations, and a real Conclusion (Section 5) that closes the loop. The three compact figures each carry the pitch solo: Fig 1's dual storyboard makes the contrast legible without the text, Fig 2's two-band layout shows organize+retrieve with the gate outcomes countable, and Fig 3's evidence cards plus aggregate strip let a reader verify the central claim (grounding vs. verification vs. citation split) from the figure alone. Numbers spot-check cleanly against the fact sheet: 9/10–6/10–9/10 grounded, 9–6–6 keyword-verified, 7–4–1 part/section citations, 113 s/$0.49 vs 43 s/$0.16 vs 48 s/$0.18, 7.6/4.4/2.4 tool calls, 322 parts, 35 near-pairs, 165/165, 15/15, 4,528 chunks, 0.75/0.66 BQ04 trace, 1/8 failure-probe score, ~3x cost (0.49/0.16 = 3.1x). The BQ06/BQ08 conservative-grading examples (0/1, 0/2) reconcile with the graded artifact (gold_hit true, kw_ok false on track b). The newly tightened prose is dense but grammatical throughout; no clipped sentences found. Body ends on page 4; page 5 holds only the GenAI disclosure and references [1]-[8], per the CFP. Acceptance-ready apart from the single user-pending item below (G1-1), which is administrative, not a paper defect.
strengths: Complete arc from problem to system to demonstration to measured evidence, ending in a substantive Conclusion rather than trailing off
Figures are self-sufficient: each of Figs. 1-3 communicates its slice of the pitch without requiring the body text, and Fig 3's aggregate strip doubles as the results table
Evaluation honesty is a feature, not a hedge: the BQ02 grounding miss is disclosed as-is, conservative grading failures are itemized, and 'operational, not controlled' is stated plainly
Every number is artifact-derived and reconciles (fact sheet, audit_paper_numbers.json, exp_r2_grade.json), including the exact per-trace counts shown in Fig 3 timelines
Demo logistics are concrete and verifiable: video URL, repository quick start, saved-trace fallback for the 15 s-3 min live latency range
Formatting compliant: 4-page body, page 5 limited to GenAI disclosure plus references
